Score only exact shared (origin_at, target_at, horizon) pairs with mature outcomes and report exclusions/failures; predeclare dependence-aware uncertainty and family-wise multiplicity correction over every candidate, comparison, and stratum.

next_action: Reopen only after the upstream diagnosis and every applicable source, provenance, licensing, operational, and frozen-evaluation gate is evidenced.
